The reciprocal-rank branch of _merge_rankings and _calculate_rrf is adapted
in retrieval_engine/evidence_priority.py. The zero-based constant 61 and weighted two-list
fusion formula are retained.

Modifications: accept LlamaIndex NodeWithScore objects; return independent
selection scores instead of replacing original relevance scores; use stable
evidence-role ranks with neutral unknown slots; recognize conservative explicit
customer-review requests; count repeated node IDs once for fusion while retaining
all objects in the ordering helper; validate weights and handle empty inputs.
The role policy and intent cues are local integration decisions, not claims
that upstream Haystack supplies source-quality classification.
Callers remain responsible for relevance floors/margins and evidence validation.
No model downloads, generative inference or provider calls are performed.

The accompanying LICENSE contains the upstream Apache License, Version 2.0.
